items.title: The Silent Consensus
items.summary: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

items.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
items.summary: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

items.title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
items.summary: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.

items.title: Inside the Codex sandbox
items.summary: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

items.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
items.summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.
